[[Nil Zone|Halloween 2025 Live Event]] |first_wave_appearance = 14 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]2,000 (Nil Zone)
[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]100 (Sandbox) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Swift (10) |cash = {{Money|2,000}} on death |spawned_by = *[[Corrupted Conserver (Nil Zone)|Corrupted Conserver]] *[[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Freeze}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Lost Performers}}''' - Upon death, spawns either the [[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] (25% chance), [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2]] (25% chance) or [[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]] (50% chance) with random attributes. }} ==Description== The '''Enigma''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It had a decent amount of health with swift speed. The '''Enigma''' has [[Freeze Immunity]], meaning it cannot be frozen or chilled by freezing towers. It can be spawned by the [[Corrupted Conserver (Nil Zone)|Corrupted Conserver]] and the [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]]. ==Appearance== The '''Enigma''' has a black body with a glowing pink question mark on its torso and a single pink glowing eye. It emitsblack and purple mist when killed. ==Enemies Summoned== The '''Enigma''' could summon three enemies, that being the [[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] with a 25% chance, [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2]] with a 25% chance and [[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]] with a 50% chance. However, each one could spawn with a random attribute, with these being: *None (18.18% chance) *[[Nimble]] (27.27% chance) *[[Bloated]] (9.09% chance) *[[Health Regen]] (18.18% chance) *[[Aggro]] (9.09% chance) *[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] (18.18% chance) ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *While on its own it has quite low health, the enemies it summons have much higher health. **High DPS towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **As the enemies it summons have potential to be [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], it is preferable that the towers used to kill it have hidden detection. *The '''Enigma''' is quite fast, way faster than any of its summons. This allows it to summon enemies way later on the path. **Freezing towers cannot be used to stall it, as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]], though all other forms of stalling are not affected. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EnigmaSpawn.gif|Unused spawning animation EnigmaWalk.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) EnigmaStun.gif|Stun animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseEnigma.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} EnigmaIconIG.png|'''EnigmaA''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.2b]] **'''Enigma''' added. *'''4 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.2d]] **'''Enigma''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''11 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.4a]] **'''Enigma''' re-added to the main game in the [[Nil Zone]]. **Health decreased from 2,500 to 2,000 in [[Nil Zone]]. *'''12 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.4b]] **'''Enigma''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{AdminAbuseLiveEvent|[[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]], [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2]] & [[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]]|Wave 13|Enigma|Wave 14|[[Unknown Boss]] & [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]]|Wave 15}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Enigma}}
